Super Mario Odyssey — Is It Still the Best 3D Mario?

Nintendo Switch · Updated 2026-08-05

Super Mario Odyssey is the globe-trotting 3D platformer that pairs Mario with Cappy, a hat that lets you "capture" and control enemies and objects. Years on, many still call it the best 3D Mario ever made.

What you get

  • Dozens of sandbox "kingdoms" built for exploration and replay
  • The capture mechanic — possess a T-Rex, a bullet bill, a taxi
  • Collectathon depth: 800+ moon collectibles for completionists
  • Two-player co-op (one drives Mario, one drives Cappy)

Why it's often discounted

Unlike brand-new releases, Odyssey is a mature title that regularly appears in Nintendo's budget "Selects" range and seasonal eShop sales. It's one of the easier first-party games to find under MSRP.

Digital vs physical

Same rule as always: digital for instant access, physical if you want to trade it in. The install is moderate, so storage isn't a deciding factor.
